review_type: Final canonical still-keyframe evidence aggregation after repair adoption
status: 55 canonical keyframe slots approved for held still reel; motion and rendered-overlay review are separate
method: Aggregates SHA-matching early and middle actual-pixel reviews with late actual-pixel review, native detail crops, targeted repair inspections and independent director approvals. The late reviewer directly reinspected final k37–k41 full frames after adoption. This is not a claim that one reviewer performed every earlier detailed inspection. All current hashes were checked against the applicable review or adopted generation record.
current_caveats: k10 and other neutral preparation poses do not demonstrate a completed heel touch or phrase; actual weight transfer and retreat direction need motion review.

Hand-contact details and small wide-frame clasps need motion close inspection for distinct wrists/fingers, contact stability and grounded turns. Inward screen direction is locked; preserve each supplied shot's offered arm rather than imposing an inconsistent anatomical side.

Crossing images establish separate platforms, level connections and before/after occupancy. Several natural steps, full traversal, gate mechanics, landing and the selected action duration remain unverified.

Small geography figures cannot certify portrait-scale identity. The rendered Chinese subtitle version must preserve visible feet and gestures, particularly in tighter seated/story frames such as k29, k32, k37 and k40. This report has not inspected baked overlays.

k52/k54 intentionally reuse the same sea-facing settled tableau. Partial side decks remain at the edges; their coda departure is a future-motion target, not proven by these held frames. k37/k38 separately establish Lin staying on I while A becomes distant.
Water, garment folds and shoe surface details vary mildly among retained images. These still approvals do not certify temporal texture or costume stability in generated motion.
